finding.text: The new page never renders: `ai/page.js` `route()` checks `CONCEPTS` before the folder probe, and `concepts.js` line 101 already has `slug: "readmes"`, so /framework/ai/readmes/ draws the old "Readmes" concept page (page 5, requirement 1). Proof: all four shots of shots/monorepo-localhost-framework-ai-readmes/ show the concept page's bullet list ("Every folder's readme.md tells an agent where it is…"), with no filter box and no table; layout.json widest_text_sample is that sentence. The file comment at `ai/page.js` line 4 warns about this order. Fix: rename the concept slug, or fold the table into the concept page, then shoot again.

Because of finding 1, none of these shots show the change, so every layout, sizing, wrapping, spacing and colour answer below comes from reading the diff, not from a picture. The task needs new shots once the route is fixed, and then this review run again.

Clicking a folder fills a panel under a 28em grid, which pushes the chain below the table, and the chosen folder has no URL. The plan (agent-context/plan.md row 5) named `/framework/ai/readmes/?path=Servex/agents` (navigation 10, page 6).

The owner's ask was "see the chain and linked readmes in layers, with tokens" (agent-context/requirements.md line 16). This change ships the chain only. That matches the plan's "slice zero", but the layers are still open and should be filed as the next slice.
The CSS uses constant spacing (`gap: 0.8em`, `padding: 0.8em … 2em`) where the spacing clamp tokens (`--gap`, `--pad`) should be used (spacing 37).

The shots do not show the change: they were taken at monorepo.localhost (the main tree, which does not have the branch), so every `/framework/ai/readmes/` shot still draws the old "Readmes" concept page (requirements 1, 3) — shots/monorepo-localhost-framework-ai-readmes/sheet.png, and layout.json's widest_text_sample is the concept's gist "Every folder's readme.md tells an agent…" at every width. Shoot the worktree (or merge to a preview) and review again; until then nothing about the new page's layout is proven.

The code fix for requirement 1 looks right: the concept slug is now `readme-system` and `readmes` is a declared child of `ai/page.js`. The concept tiles are generated from `CONCEPTS`, so they follow the new slug. About 15 old docs link `/framework/ai/readmes/` meaning "the readme chain"; those links now open the new page, which shows the chain, so they still make sense.

Requirement 3: the chain panel and the grid share `.rm-body`, an auto-fit grid with columns of at least 30em, so at wide widths they sit side by side. But before any folder is chosen, the panel is an empty column taking half the width. Show a one-line hint there, or let the grid span the whole width until a folder is clicked (layout, wasted space). Not measured, because there is no shot.

Requirement 5 is only partly met: `.rm-view` and `.rm-body` use `--gap` and `--pad`, but `.rm-filter` still has `padding: 0.5em 0.7em` and `.rm-item` still has `gap: 0.2em 1em` — ReadmesView.css lines 4 and 11.
The brief's process steps are not visible in this folder: there is no `session.jsonl` answering the earlier findings, and no child task for the layered view.

The rename broke the concept's own page: `ai/page.js` line 172 still tests `c.slug === "readmes"`, so the "Readme system" concept page has lost its "The chain, live" section (requirement 1: "without breaking the concept's other links"). Change the test to `"readme-system"`.

The chain does not visibly sit beside the grid at wide widths (requirement 3). shots/readmes-worktree/3440.png and 1920.png: the grid takes the left half and the right half is blank, with not even the "Click a folder to see its chain here." prompt. No shot was taken at `?path=Servex/agents`, so the chosen-folder URL and the side-by-side chain are unproven.
The "Chain tokens" and "Own tokens" headers wrap to two lines, and the top line is cut off, at every width (wrapping 1). shots/readmes-worktree/400.png, header row; 3440.png, header row.
At 400 the Folder column shows only "public/i…" and "public/f…", so the one column a reader needs can't be read (sizing). shots/readmes-worktree/400.png, table band.

The title "Readmes" sits flush against the left edge with no page padding, and a big empty gap (about 80px at 3440) separates it from the intro (spacing). shots/readmes-worktree/400.png top band (title at x=0); 3440.png bands 1–2.

The measured layout.json describes the wrong page. shots/monorepo-localhost-framework-ai-readmes/ was shot on the main site, which still draws the old concept page (sheet.png). Only shots/readmes-worktree/ shows the change, and it has no layout.json. The spacing, sizing and wrapping answers below are therefore judged by eye.

At 1920 the table is not held to `--datagrid-height: 28em`: the full-page shot runs 4000px with the sticky header repeating over the rows. At 3440 it is clipped correctly. shots/readmes-worktree/1920.png.
The next slice (the layered view) was recorded only as a log line in session.jsonl, not filed as a child task as the brief asked.
At 3440 the intro paragraph runs about 1900px on one line, well past a readable measure. shots/readmes-worktree/3440.png, band 2.
